text: Well folks, it's another week and the top of the standings looks tighter than a crease battle in front of the net, with JeE-DeY, Frank's team, and Mon-Q all jostling within a single point, though JeE-DeY managed to nudge up two spots thanks to some sneaky add/drops. The biggest mover this week, and I mean *by far*, is Jd's nightmares, jumping a staggering five spots after what has to be an absolute point explosion from Petpou's roster. Look, there's no real drama at the top, just sheer, unadulterated pressure, but down at the bottom, Eddy's is making a valiant, if somewhat desperate, climb, while Connor McCelery took a five-spot tumble that Yanic Larouche would rather forget. I'm telling you, this week is going to see a serious shake-up, and I wouldn't bet against La saucisse and the Green Jackets making a real run at that top three if things break their way.
